fem.text: Tevesh Szat begins as Tev, who is caught up with his sister Tymolin in the Brothers' War with disastrous results, which leaves him guilt-ridden and exiled from society in Sarpadia. When the Farrelites ambush Tev and Tymolin, he escapes with a Darkness spell, but the siblings are separated.

Sensing her death, Tev transforms into the dragon-like Tevesh Szat and incinerates Vaylesh, Oliver and Sianna and their forces. He then vows to destroy the Sarpadian empires from within and unleashes the Orc-Goblin army on Montford through a Planar Gate, and Icatia finally falls with his aid.

ice.text: Szat corrupts King Miko, giving him the Staff of Ice Lords and manipulating him into ordering a duel between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion, in which Storgard is damaged. In the end those who stayed in the city are swallowed by the glacier.

At the Summit of the Null Moon, Szat kills Chromium Rhuell and reveals that he is in league with Faralyn and Leshrac and plans to silence Dominaria, and he plans to leave Dominaria in eternal slumber under ice. Freyalise fights him on Azoria and is blinded by him, so she enlists the inexperienced Jaeuhl Carthalion to banish him.

Jaeuhl finds the Amulet of Quoz and defeats Szat, who escapes with Lim-Dul through a portal to Shandalar and is defeated there by Kenan Sahrmal. Much later Urza recruits him for the Nine Titans, but Szat betrays them, killing Daria and Kristina, and Urza, who foresaw the betrayal, uses his life energy to fuel the soul bombs that devastate Phyrexia.
